Package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui

package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.gui
JavaFX graphical user interface (the "V" in MVC). GUIApp starts the application and handles scene transitions (login, board, leaderboard); the FXML controllers (BoardController, LeaderboardController, ...) connect the views to the ClientModel and send actions via VirtualServer.
